content:
Let the roots be \(z,\bar z,w,\bar w\). Since the product is non-real, the two roots whose product is \(13+i\) must be one from each conjugate pair. Relabel so that

\[
zw=13+i.
\]

Then the other two roots are \(\bar z,\bar w\), so

\[
\bar z+\bar w=3+4i \implies z+w=3-4i.
\]

Write \(z=x+iy,\ w=u+iv\). Then

\[
x+u=3,\qquad y+v=-4,
\]
and from \(zw=13+i\),

\[
xu-yv=13.
\]

The coefficient \(b\) is the sum of products of roots two at a time:

\[
b=z\bar z+w\bar w+(z+\bar z)(w+\bar w).
\]

Thus

\[
b=x^2+y^2+u^2+v^2+4xu.
\]

Using \(x+u=3,\ y+v=-4\),

\[
x^2+y^2+u^2+v^2=(x+u)^2+(y+v)^2-2xu-2yv
=9+16-2xu-2yv.
\]

So

\[
b=25-2xu-2yv+4xu
=25+2(xu-yv)
=25+2(13)
=51.
\]

\[
\boxed{51}
\]
